notes.title: Update #2 for Windows is available now
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

A small update is rolling out now for Windows which contains the following changes:
[list]
[*]Updated nGlide from 1.04 to 2.00,
[*]Updated install instructions to include DirectX 9.0c when first starting the game.
[/list] 
Regards,
Daniel G,
Night Dive Studios

notes.title: FLAC soundtrack added and MacOS version fixed
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers,

A small update is out now for Wizardry 8, no changes in the Windows version other than the addition of the FLAC version of the soundtrack. The MacOS version has received fixes which will allow it to start on High Sierra as well as an upgrade to Wine 2.16 over 1.7.54.

Daniel
Nightdive Studfios

notes.title: New update out now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A small update for Wizardry 8 is available now. It contains the following:

[list]

[*] (Mac OS X) The game will now launch on OS X 10.11

[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Wizard! Wizardry VI, VII, and 8 Are Now For Sale On Steam
notes.notes:
Night Dive, the people who managed to retrieve System Shock 2 from the abyss and release it once more, are back. And this time they’ve brought Wizardry VI, VII and 8 with them. All three are now on Steam, in working-on-a-modern-PC-versions. It’s time to party.

(more…)

notes.title: Now Available - Wizardry 6, 7, and 8
notes.notes:
Wizardry 6: Bane of the Cosmic Forge, Wizardry 7: Crusaders of the Dark Savant, and Wizardry 8 are Now Available on Steam

Three classic installments of the Wizardry series of role-playing games are now available on Steam!
